# Maintenance

A switch, a label and a checklist all fail in different ways. The question I now need is how a room continues to work when the person who knows its exceptions is away. A repaired printer is only part of a working admissions desk. Someone must be allowed to use handwritten tickets when it breaks again.

Record the owner, fallback and review date beside each recurring obligation. A pending tray is useful only if a decision can leave it. Make the ordinary state visible with a photograph, and test instructions with a person who did not write them. [[Volunteer handbook]] should let people continue safely rather than require them to wait for Jo. Keep the older object repair examples in their individual notes; this page is becoming about the arrangements that let care and repair continue.
